name: What is gas line isolation and capping?

mainEntity.name: What is gas line isolation and capping?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gas line isolation and capping is the process of safely shutting off and sealing a section of a natural gas line that is damaged or no longer needed. This prevents gas leaks, ensures safety, and allows for repairs or decommissioning of appliances. A qualified technician will typically turn off the gas supply, cut the damaged section, and install a secure cap or plug, ensuring the remaining gas system is safe and functional.
acceptedAnswer.description: Gas line isolation and capping involves safely shutting off and sealing a damaged or unused section of a gas line to prevent leaks.
